defect_32.verdict: MATCH -- meologue's Label name field now has maxLength=60 and a live 'N/60' counter, incrementing identically to Todoist's own dialog at every keystroke (0/60 empty, 8/60 after 'zz probe'). Previously (flow9) meologue's name input had no maxLength and no counter at all.
